name: Jaazaniah
overview: Jaazaniah is a male biblical figure identified uniquely as the son of Shaphan, as recorded in Ezekiel 8:11. There is no tribal affiliation or additional notes provided about him. His mention is brief but specific, anchoring him within the context of prophetic scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Jaazaniah means 'YHWH listens,' reflecting a theologically significant meaning rooted in the Hebrew language. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God, but it conveys a sense of divine attentiveness. The sole recorded instance of this name is found in Ezekiel 8:11.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Jaazaniah as the son of Shaphan, according to Ezekiel 8:11. Beyond this father-son relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jaazaniah's significance lies in his mention within the prophetic vision of Ezekiel, emphasizing his role within the narrative context of that passage. Being the son of Shaphan may associate him with a family known in the biblical record, highlighting his place among those contemporaneous with the prophet. His presence in Ezekiel 8:11 situates him within a moment of divine revelation and judgment, contributing to the overall message of the prophecy.
